verdicts.reason: A: the white serif headline sits on the cream circle, so the most important text almost disappears (a critical contrast failure), even though the large bottle and stacked NEW/Try It pills are well composed. B: the headline is bold and readable, but the bottle is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the top edge, with a stray clipped decorative circle behind it. The NEW and Try It pills are oversized, have different widths and ragged left edges, and leave a dead empty block at bottom-left. B is flawed but usable; A's headline isn't readable.
